description: This file defines the ReportsScreen widget for the attendance tracker app, which displays daily and weekly attendance summaries with options to pick dates and fetch data via a ReportProvider.

classes.name: ReportsScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that manages the state for the reports display page, including date pickers and fetching data.

classes.name: _ReportsScreenState
classes.description: State class for ReportsScreen managing dates, loading states, and UI interactions.

methods.name: _mondayOf
methods.description: Calculates the Monday of the week for a given date.

methods.name: _fetchDaily
methods.description: Triggers fetching of daily report data for the selected day.

methods.name: _fetchWeekly
methods.description: Triggers fetching of weekly report data starting from the selected week start.

methods.name: _pickDay
methods.description: Opens a date picker to select a day and updates the state.

methods.name: _pickWeek
methods.description: Opens a date picker to select a date and updates the week start to the corresponding Monday.

methods.name: _dateKey
methods.description: Generates a string key in 'yyyy-MM-dd' format for the date.
